title: Maximum Number of Coins You Can Get
goal: Maximize your coins when Alice takes the largest and Bob the smallest of each chosen triple.
strategy: Reserve the smallest piles for Bob. Pair each of your choices with the largest remaining pile for Alice, taking the second-largest yourself.
